name: nook-workspace
description: Convenience scripts; the frontend and the backend are independent npm projects (no shared node_modules).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
